description: We visit the hotels, leasing offices and workplaces near your restaurant or cafe in Elmhurst, Naperville and Downers Grove, and track every sign-up.
cardBlurb: We visit the hotels and offices where people ask where to eat.
intro: We find businesses near you that share your customers. Every month we visit them and introduce your restaurant or cafe by name.

portalNote: Each sign-up lands in your portal, ready for your team to follow up.

notes.title: A one-page partner agreement
notes.text: When our team visits, you and each partner agree to promote each other. Nobody is paid per referral or per customer.

notes.title: No competing kitchens
notes.text: We never visit other restaurants, cafes, bakeries or bars for you.

notes.title: Your menu, your words
notes.text: We describe your restaurant or cafe only in words you approve.

exclusivity: When our team visits, partners agree to promote one restaurant or cafe like yours, and only yours, for as long as you are a client.

faq.q: Can we keep the relationships we already have?
faq.a: Yes. We skip businesses you already work with unless you ask, and those relationships stay yours.

faq.q: Most of my customers just walk in. What counts as a sign-up?
faq.a: Someone who taps or scans a staff member's card and fills in your form. Your portal shows where each one came from.

faq.q: Do I need to come along on the visits?
faq.a: No. Our field team makes every visit. Your part is approving the list and following up on sign-ups.
